channel.title: PatelsVine
channel.description: India news, technology, politics, economy and events explained clearly.

item.title: India's 2026 Assembly Verdict: What Five State Results Signal
item.description: The May 2026 assembly results across Assam, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, West Bengal, and Puducherry point to a more competitive and fragmented federal map.

item.title: QR Codes at Counting Centres: Why ECI's New Access System Matters
item.description: The Election Commission's QR-based identity cards add a digital layer to the most sensitive point of the counting process.

item.title: Supreme Court Judge Strength May Rise to 37: The Governance Case
item.description: The Cabinet has approved a proposal to increase Supreme Court judge strength from 33 to 37, excluding the Chief Justice of India.

item.title: Two New Semiconductor Units in Gujarat: Why the May 2026 Approval Is Bigger Than One State
item.description: India's semiconductor push added two more projects, including a commercial Mini/Micro-LED display facility and a packaging unit.

item.title: IndiaAI in 2026: Compute, Sovereign Models, and the Race to Make AI Useful
item.description: IndiaAI's 2026 progress shows a practical focus: cheaper compute, Indian-language models, startup support, and public-good AI infrastructure.

item.title: UPI at 10: India's Payments Network Is Now Public Infrastructure
item.description: UPI's first decade moved it from a payment feature to a national transaction layer used by consumers, merchants, banks, and startups.

item.title: ECLGS 5.0 and West Asia Stress: Why Indian Airlines Needed a Credit Buffer
item.description: The Cabinet's ECLGS 5.0 approval links airline credit support to fuel prices, airspace closures, and route disruptions connected to West Asia tensions.

item.title: Vadinar Ship Repair Facility: A Maritime Bet on Keeping Value in India
item.description: The approved Vadinar facility aims to repair large vessels domestically and reduce dependence on foreign shipyards.

item.title: 901 Km of Railway Multitracking: The Logistics Story Behind Three Projects
item.description: Three approved railway multitracking projects will add capacity across 19 districts in six states and aim to improve freight and passenger reliability.

item.title: Mission for Cotton Productivity: India's 2031 Target and the 5F Supply Chain
item.description: The Rs 5,659.22 crore cotton mission aims to raise lint productivity, support farmers, improve quality, and strengthen textile competitiveness.

item.title: Sugarcane FRP at Rs 365/qtl for 2026-27: What Farmers and Mills Should Watch
item.description: The approved Fair and Remunerative Price for sugarcane in the 2026-27 sugar season is Rs 365 per quintal at a basic recovery rate of 10.25 percent.

item.title: Rugby Premier League 2026 in Hyderabad: Why This Event Matters Beyond One Tournament
item.description: The second Rugby Premier League will be held at Gachibowli Stadium from June 16 to 28, 2026, giving Hyderabad another sports-economy moment.

item.title: Defence Tech in 2026: AI, Hypersonics, Quantum, and the New Preparedness Debate
item.description: The North Tech Symposium underscored India's push toward emerging defence technologies and a larger domestic production base.
